title: Green and Yellow
label: ch:ge-green-and-yellow
canDo: I can name green and yellow in German, and say why grün is English green's own cousin while gelb's link to French jaune is only probable.

payoff.summary: Say grün as the direct cousin of English green from a root unrelated to Latin viridis, say gelb, and state the gelb / jaune cousinhood as probable rather than airtight. The chapter's only lesson, so the payoff covers everything it introduces.
